records.answer:
The first step in the emergency rollback procedure is to freeze the rollout by pausing any in-flight progressive delivery jobs to prevent further canary expansion.

For Hosted environments, the rollback involves pausing the rollout, pinning the runtime release tag to the target version, triggering a redeploy, verifying health metrics, and locking the tag to prevent auto-advance.

For Dedicated environments, the procedure requires identifying impacted clusters via the Console dashboard and then pinning the specific runtime release tag per cluster.
